bytes_per_tick_source: Plan SW-R8.1: 0-allocation hot path. Enforced by the counting allocator (tests/alloc_gate.rs, 10 000 ticks per section) and the alloc_probe_* benches (panic on any allocation). Any allocation is a BUG with its site, never a reason to raise this.
description: Phase B5 benchmark gate thresholds (SW-R8.1). Enforced by tools/rsh-benchmarks/check-thresholds.py over `cargo bench -p rsh-benchmarks` criterion estimates; the allocation gate is additionally enforced in-process by tests/alloc_gate.rs and the alloc_probe_* benches, and the soak gate by tests/soak.rs (60 s proxy) plus the Phase H 10-min rig soak.
hot_path_tick_ns_source: Measured baseline on this machine (3 criterion runs, 2026-11-14): hot_path_parse_seq_pipeline mean-of-means 335.6 ns (runs 335.0 / 330.9 / 340.8); threshold = measured x 1.2 = 403 ns (+20% headroom). Re-measure on a new machine; do not raise without a new measurement.

measured_baseline_ns.note: Mean-of-means of 3 `cargo bench -p rsh-benchmarks --bench engine` runs, 2026-11-14. Runs: pipeline 154.5 / 176.6 / 157.2 ns; hot path 335.0 / 330.9 / 340.8 ns; seq+watchdog 13.9 / 14.0 / 13.8 ns. Pipeline spread ~14% run-to-run on this shared host; all runs far under the 1100 ns plan cap.

pipeline_tick_ns_source: C# baseline (RSH-RUST-ARCHITECTURE.md Phase B / RSH-RUST-SOFTWARE-PLAN.md SW-R8.1): pipeline tick <= 1.1 us/tick. Measured Rust baseline on this machine (3 runs, 2026-11-14): mean-of-means 162.8 ns — 6.8x under the cap; the cap is the plan SLO, not the measured number.
soak_growth_source: RSH-RUST-SOFTWARE-PLAN.md SW-R8.3: memory flatness <= 1 MB / 10 min. The 60 s proxy in tests/soak.rs asserts 0 net heap bytes (pro-rated budget ~100 KiB/60 s) and RSS growth within the full 1 MiB; the full 10-min soak is the Phase H release gate.
